purpose: Remove quadratic quota-grown spill-cache recounts and replace repeated large-field owning-token analysis reuse with compact normalized alias replay.

methodology.scope: Optimized native spill and capture kernels, with separate Debug native indexing and real-file HTTP correctness qualification.
methodology.residency_baseline: Frozen quota-governed probe from f73f851f05112e7f016132cd1402ee41d80ec342 (runtime 04e87128ffef7efe9fb1ea0fee64ae29e4651ae7, main f91c9c0e4682a3ff20e39fce9a44d67b658a7b55). The identical harness is SHA-verified. Merged main changes do not reach the exercised native spill kernel; this is not a same-main whole-server speedup claim.
methodology.pairing: One excluded warmup per variant/cohort, then three alternating measured pairs. No task-owned builds, tests or cleanup overlap final measurements. Other host activity and OS caches are uncontrolled.
methodology.cache_controls: Both variants use quota-governed residency, the same hard quotas, a 4-MiB workspace and complete value/key/ordinal/NULL oracles. Reads, writes, payload decodes, roots and merge counts must match.
methodology.cache_timing: CAPACITY includes the complete leased drain and all oracles; TYPED_MERGE includes add, finish, drain and sort teardown. Manager construction and process startup are excluded.
methodology.capture_controls: One and two bindings, simple and English analyzers, repeated four-term and diverse 4096-term fixtures. Each variant analyzes once, visits every binding, encodes offsets once, and retires temporary owners during timing. Input, token/span and complete encoded-byte fingerprints must match across all samples.
methodology.capture_timing: Includes analysis, callback validation, encoding and temporary teardown. Excludes immutable input generation, analyzer fingerprinting, process startup, encoded-output verification and final Capture teardown. Callback hashes stand in for consumers, not complete postings construction.
methodology.memory: Tracked allocator high-water bytes exclude immutable capture input; they are not peak RSS. Quotas are unchanged within every pair.
methodology.capacity_controls: Separate 64-MiB quota controls expect materialized OutOfMemory and successful compact replay. These are negative capacity controls, not failing product tests.

limitations: Compact alias replay materially lowers tracked memory but adds CPU in the capture kernel. It is retained for bounded working memory and quota availability, not claimed as an unconditional ingestion throughput improvement.

Current evidence makes no optimized-server throughput, HTTP publication latency, cloud retention, archive-scale, cold-cache or RSS claim. Earlier observations retain their own source/binary identities.
